dct_description_sm: Specimens for this study (adults of the holothuroid sea cucumber Psolus fabricii) were collected by SCUBA in summer (July) 2020 and winter (February) 2022 in Logy Bay (47.625346°, -52.663430°) and Tappers Cove (47.6655003°, -52.727010°), Newfoundland, Canada at a depth of 8-13 m.

This study demonstrated that explanted epidermal, connective, neural and muscle tissue from the sea cucumber Psolus fabricii (Holothuroidea: Echinodermata), healed and continued to grow in natural, non-axenic seawater without supplementation for over three years. 	
This data set contains the raw and processed data that supporting the findings of the study.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Natural tissue immortality: Indefinite survival of sea cucumber explants
